faqBookingAnswer: You submit a booking request with your preferred time slot and number of seats. The provider then confirms it — you'll be notified once that happens.
faqCancellationAnswer: Yes, you can cancel from My Bookings while your request is pending or confirmed. Once an experience is in progress or completed, cancellation is no longer available.
